entries.title: Agent Skills specification
entries.summary: A skill uses a SKILL.md entry point with metadata and progressive references.

entries.title: DTCG stable format 2025.10
entries.summary: Design tokens use typed values and explicit references before platform compilation.

entries.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
entries.summary: New and changed product interfaces must meet WCAG 2.2 AA, including focus, input, target, and status behavior.

entries.title: prefers-reduced-motion
entries.summary: Non-essential movement needs a reduced-motion alternative that preserves meaning and operation.

entries.title: Storybook accessibility testing
entries.summary: Component stories provide repeatable accessibility and state evidence during development and CI.

entries.title: Playwright visual comparisons
entries.summary: Reviewed screenshots can detect visual drift across explicit browser and viewport conditions.

entries.title: Use containment with intent
entries.summary: Repeated equal cards are a blocking heuristic when they replace page hierarchy rather than express contained objects or actions.

entries.title: Transparent consequential AI
entries.summary: AI work exposes scope, progress, sources, uncertainty, errors, cancellation, and human approval before consequential actions.

entries.title: Motion frequency determines strength
entries.summary: Repeated micro-motion stays short and restrained; strong choreography is reserved for rare explanatory moments.

entries.title: Required design contracts exist
entries.summary: Product truth, design decisions, component coverage, tokens, project configuration, exceptions, and review evidence must be present.

entries.title: Design axes are explicit
entries.summary: Expression, density, motion, and warmth each use a justified integer from 1 to 10.

entries.title: Token source follows DTCG 2025.10
entries.summary: The token source declares DTCG 2025.10 and names independently composed light and dark color groups.

entries.title: Implementation colors use tokens
entries.summary: Production UI does not bypass the project token source with raw color literals.

entries.title: Transitions are scoped and responsive
entries.summary: Interactive transitions name their properties and avoid routine ease-in arrivals or transition-all behavior.

entries.title: Motion has a reduced path
entries.summary: Interfaces with motion include reduced-motion behavior, and infinite motion has a same-system stop.

entries.title: Controls preserve focus and button behavior
entries.summary: Buttons declare their type and focus outlines are removed only when a visible focus replacement exists.

entries.title: Component contracts cover complete states
entries.summary: The component contract records loading, empty, partial, error, success, disabled, permission, offline, and responsive behavior.

entries.title: Card repetition has purpose
entries.summary: Large equal-card grids must represent real containment or comparison instead of replacing page hierarchy.

entries.title: One icon vocabulary
entries.summary: A product surface uses one coherent icon library unless a scoped exception documents a migration.

entries.title: Visual review evidence is complete and current
entries.summary: Explicit viewport, input, accessibility, theme, content, and source-hash review evidence must be reviewed and fresh.

entries.title: New systems compile dark theme output
entries.summary: Projects that require a dark theme compile an explicit dark selector rather than assuming token names are sufficient.

entries.title: Golden-stack stories cover critical variants
entries.summary: Storybook evidence includes themes, core states, long content, permissions, and reduced motion.

entries.title: High-cost visual behavior is measured
entries.summary: Persistent will-change, large blur, and JavaScript scroll listeners produce performance review warnings.

entries.title: App shells use resilient viewport height
entries.summary: Application shells avoid fixed 100vh behavior that breaks with dynamic browser chrome and content growth.

entries.title: Project contracts are valid JSON with current schemas
entries.summary: Malformed or invalid configuration cannot silently fall back to unchecked defaults. Version 1 config remains readable only as a migration warning.

entries.title: AI surfaces remain transparent and controlled
entries.summary: AI contracts expose progress, sources, uncertainty, cancellation, and approval before consequential actions.

entries.title: Operational tables have complete contracts
entries.summary: Each declared work or editable table has a stable ID and a matching valid contract for its columns, capabilities, states, preferences, and profile.

entries.title: Table evidence is present and current
entries.summary: Table contracts point to existing component stories, browser tests, and visual review evidence whose source hash is current.

entries.title: Precision interactions have accessible alternatives
entries.summary: Column reorder and resize are never drag-only or pointer-only, full values stay reachable, and grid semantics require complete keyboard focus behavior.

entries.title: Produced text avoids the forbidden long dash
entries.summary: Generated UI, copy, documents, stories, templates, and handoffs cannot contain the character or an HTML, JavaScript, or CSS form that renders it.

entries.title: Visible surface structure is unique
entries.summary: Each rendered surface keeps heading level and text pairs unique, each app shell has at most one top-level banner and contentinfo landmark, and each visible dialog has at most one icon-only close control.

entries.title: Dropdown text remains legible in both themes
entries.summary: Selects, comboboxes, listboxes, and enabled option states need executable light and dark proof of at least 4.5:1 text contrast plus complete popup behavior.

entries.title: Exceptions are scoped, approved, and dated
entries.summary: A rule bypass names its rule, target, reason, approver, and a valid future review date.
